issue.title: Next UI: Round button and Progress ring
issue.body:
Next UI components for the Listen and Record screens, built with the `figma-component` workflow from #638. Batched into one PR by request (Joe Skager) since both are small, front-end only, and the ring wraps the button in Figma.

Figma: [Round button](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2326-64) · [Progress ring](https://www.figma.com/design/VZ23XV2pxvIIAMn12wI4YI/ETEN-x-Fluent?node-id=2400-302)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `RoundButton` renders Style Soft / Flat × Default / Pressed / Disabled from Figma `2326:64` using only theme tokens; Flat is pinned to Canvas colors; Soft has the 1px `border/rim` ring
- [ ] Press: Soft sinks to `surface/sunken` + `elevation/inset`, Flat to `surface/sunken`; icon nudges 2px; Figma motion tokens; reduce motion snaps; `press` haptic on press-in (Next only, silent during a take)
- [ ] `ProgressRing` renders None / In progress / Complete from Figma `2400:302`, driven by a 0–1 value, 3px `fg/inactive` track with an `accent/primary` arc from 12 o'clock, and centers a child (the Round button)
- [ ] Progress is announced to TalkBack (progress bar role with a percent value)
- [ ] `stroke/1`, `stroke/2` reachable through `useTheme()` (needed by the rim)
- [ ] Gallery demos show both doing their real job: passage rows for *The Last Supper* (Soft button + listening-progress ring, None / In progress / Complete, play and pause) and the Canvas player header (Flat minimize). Round button Disabled isn't used on any Figma screen, so it's covered by unit tests rather than demoed
- [ ] Switch gallery demo reworked to its real job, the Listen / Record Mode toggle, locking while a take records
- [ ] Unit tests for both components

Needs QA? Yes (haptics and press feel need a real device)
